key_insight: SCP-FTLE and SCP-FSLE accelerate three-dimensional material-stretching and transport-barrier analysis on CPUs and GPUs while scaling efficiently to a billion seeds.
engineering_relevance: The modules enable large-scale flow-transport diagnostics, including mixing in shear-thinning cavity flows and tracer dispersion around urban buildings.
method: Support structured and native unstructured meshes with selectable integration and interpolation schemes.
Reduce data movement through rolling snapshot reuse, memory-bounded FTLE batching and device-resident trajectory state.
Use active-set FSLE advancement to reduce redundant computation.
evidence_signal: For a billion-seed benchmark, 32-GPU strong-scaling efficiencies reach 86.3% for FTLE and 95.2% for FSLE; verification uses ABC and SCVM flows for FTLE and linear stretching and rotational shear flows for FSLE.
watch_item: Performance and accuracy on new datasets should be checked against available memory, mesh characteristics and integration/interpolation choices.
paper_title: SCP-FTLE and SCP-FSLE: High-performance finite-time and finite-size Lyapunov-exponent computations for CPUs and GPUs
